steps.en: Officer indicates the decision to proceed with sending a Letter of Advice
steps.id: Officer menyatakan keputusan lanjut kirim Letter of Advice
steps.why_en: Only a text label exists; no proceed action is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada label teks; aksi lanjut tidak dibangun.

steps.en: OCMS shows the pre-populated last known address for editing
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan last known address yang terisi otomatis
steps.why_en: It is the general notice address, not a court last-known address.
steps.why_id: Ini alamat notice umum, bukan alamat terakhir court.

steps.en: Officer amends the address and saves the changes
steps.why_en: Saving works for the notice address only; the court record is not updated.
steps.why_id: Simpan jalan untuk alamat notice saja; data court tidak ikut diubah.

steps.en: OCMS shows the notice and saved defendant address for the officer to confirm
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan notice dan alamat tersimpan untuk dikonfirmasi
steps.why_en: Only a success message and page reload appear; no confirmation screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pesan sukses dan reload; layar konfirmasi tidak ada.
